General Mills is seeking an E-Commerce Packaging Engineer in their Pet Segment Operating Unit. This role will create and translate a Packaging modeling framework to help accelerate our flexible format across all of Pet with an emphasis on e-commerce. This responsibility spans across a large raw material cost of goods sold and requires strong activation and leadership to deliver against innovation and cost savings goals.

You will manage a portfolio of products through a complex manufacturing network, temperature states, and channels, providing opportunities to lead new ways of working with a variety of cross-functional partners.

• Bachelor's Degree in Packaging Engineering or other related degree fields

• Demonstrated strong agile leadership & ability to pivot quickly.
